commands.description: Estrazione puntuale: identifica entità e concetti chiave. Per ogni elemento, riporta la citazione testuale esatta (verbatim) e spiega perché è rilevante.
Sintesi densa: elimina ripetizioni e dettagli minori. Mantieni solo i punti informativi essenziali e i passaggi decisivi.
Filtro tematico: isola e raggruppa solo le parti del testo che trattano l'argomento specifico indicato.
Analisi strutturale: individua ed estrai le singole tesi, argomentazioni o catene di ragionamento presenti.
Comparazione: analizza due o più elementi evidenziando in modo preciso somiglianze, differenze e punti di contatto.
Fusione dati: unisci più testi in un unico output coerente, eliminando i doppioni e risolvendo eventuali contrasti tra le informazioni.
Task libero: esegui qualsiasi altra operazione richiesta non specificata sopra.

sources.name: disease
sources.description: Clinical and pathological information about a disease. It includes classification, etiology, pathogenesis, symptoms, affected organs, and complications. It also covers aspects related to medical management (diagnostic methods, challenges, treatments, medications), epidemiology, risk factors, prognosis, long-term consequences (sequelae), and the impact on the patient's quality of life.

sources.name: institution
sources.description: A demographic and operational profile of a research institute or medical center. It contains structural information (name, type, parent organization, year of founding, location, staff and leadership), research focuses (diseases studied and scientific fields), technologies used, and their applications. It also maps the academic and commercial context through funding sources, milestones achieved, and international collaborations.

sources.name: drug
sources.description: Technical data sheet or package leaflet for a pharmaceutical product. It includes the nomenclature (generic and trade name), therapeutic indications (diseases treated), active ingredients, manufacturer, pharmaceutical form, and route of administration. It also includes the dosage (single dose, frequency, recommended use), mechanism of action, side effects, ineligible populations, activation requirements, prescribing regulations, and storage conditions.

what.name: disease.disease_name
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the official name of the disease (e.g., Rheumatoid Arthritis)."

what.name: disease.disease_type
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "comprehensive classification of the disease; choose one or more from ['autoimmune', 'infectious', 'genetic', 'metabolic', 'neoplastic', 'degenerative', 'congenital', 'traumatic', 'nutritional', 'vascular', 'inflammatory', 'endocrine', 'psychiatric', 'toxic', 'allergic', 'iatrogenic', 'idiopathic', 'parasitic', 'others'], seperated by `||` (e.g. neoplastic || degenerative)"

what.name: disease.pathogenesis
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the biological and physiological process by which the disease develops and progresses, choose one or more from: ['autoimmune', 'infectious_bacterial', 'infectious_viral', 'infectious_fungal', 'infectious_parasitic', 'genetic_mutation', 'metabolic_disorder', 'inflammatory', 'degenerative', 'neoplastic', 'vascular', 'traumatic', 'toxic', 'allergic', 'endocrine_disorder', 'nutritional_deficiency', 'iatrogenic', 'idiopathic', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. inflammatory || degenerative)."

what.name: disease.etiology
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the underlying cause(s) of the disease, including genetic, environmental, infectious, or lifestyle factors (e.g., gene mutation, viral infection, smoking)."

what.name: disease.diagnostic_methods
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "primary diagnostic approaches used for this disease; choose one or more from ['clinical_evaluation', 'laboratory_test', 'imaging', 'biopsy', 'genetic_testing', 'endoscopy', 'functional_test', 'pathology', 'screening', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. clinical_evaluation || laboratory_test)."

what.name: disease.common_symptoms
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "typical clinical manifestations or symptoms experienced by patients with this disease (e.g., fever, cough, joint pain)."

what.name: disease.complications
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "significant secondary conditions or health problems that can arise as a result of the disease (e.g., heart failure, kidney injury)."

what.name: disease.affected_organs
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "primary organs, tissues, or body systems impacted by the disease (e.g., lungs, liver, joints, nervous system)."

what.name: disease.treatments
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "list of treatment modalities, choose one or more from ['oral_medication', 'injection', 'surgery', 'radiotherapy', 'chemotherapy', 'physical_therapy', 'psychotherapy', 'lifestyle_modification', 'device_implantation', 'dietary_intervention', 'others'], seperated by `||` (e.g. oral_medication)."

what.name: disease.drugs
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "list the specific names of drugs or pharmaceuticals used to treat or control the disease (e.g., metformin, aspirin, infliximab, penicillin)."

what.name: disease.prognosis
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "typical course and expected outcome of the disease; choose one or more from ['full_recovery', 'partial_recovery', 'chronic_condition', 'remission_possible', 'high_recurrence_risk', 'low_recurrence_risk', 'high_mortality', 'moderate_mortality', 'low_mortality', 'disability', 'variable', 'stable', 'progressive', 'quality_of_life_impairment', 'asymptomatic', 'unknown'], seperated by `||` (e.g.artial_recovery || chronic_condition)"

what.name: disease.sequelae
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "long-term or permanent health problems, symptoms, or functional impairments that persist after the acute phase of a disease or injury has resolved.(e.g., paralysis after stroke, chronic pain, hearing loss or cognitive impairment)"

what.name: disease.epidemiology
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "population-level data about the disease, including prevalence, incidence, age/gender distribution, or notable epidemiological patterns (e.g., 1 in 1000 adults, more common in males)."

what.name: disease.risk_factors
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "factors that increase the likelihood of developing the disease, choose one or more from ['family_history', 'genetic_predisposition', 'age', 'gender', 'smoking', 'alcohol_consumption', 'obesity', 'overweight', 'sedentary_lifestyle', 'unhealthy_diet', 'hypertension', 'hyperlipidemia', 'diabetes', 'chronic_disease', 'immunosuppression', 'environmental_exposure', 'occupational_exposure', 'exposure_to_toxins', 'infection', 'stress', 'low_socioeconomic_status', 'radiation_exposure', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. family_history || age)."

what.name: disease.preventive_measures
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "known methods or actions to reduce the risk of disease occurrence, choose one or more from ['vaccination', 'lifestyle_modification', 'screening', 'prophylactic_medication', 'personal_hygiene', 'health_education', 'protective_equipment', 'environmental_control', 'vector_control', 'safe_sex_practices', 'regular_exercise', 'dietary_management', 'early_detection', 'other'], , seperated by `||` (e.g. vaccination || regular_exercise)."

what.name: disease.diagnosis_challenges
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "typical difficulties or obstacles encountered in the diagnosis of the disease (e.g., nonspecific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers, disease mimics)."

what.name: disease.treatment_challenges
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "major issues in the treatment or management of the disease (e.g., drug resistance, frequent relapse, side effects, poor adherence)."

what.name: disease.quality_of_life_impact
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "how the disease affects the patient's daily living, social interactions, work, and psychological well-being choose one or more from: ['mobility_impairment', 'chronic_pain', 'fatigue', 'sleep_disorders', 'anxiety', 'depression', 'social_isolation', 'work_disability', 'cognitive_impairment', 'sexual_dysfunction', 'self_care_difficulty', 'dietary_restriction', 'dependence_on_others', 'body_image_issues', 'financial_burden', 'emotional_distress', 'stigma', 'quality_of_life_decline', 'other'], , seperated by `||` (e.g. chronic_pain || work_disability)."

what.name: institution.institution_name
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "full name of the medical research institution (e.g., National Cancer Institute, RIKEN SPring-8 Center)."

what.name: institution.institution_type
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "list of the type of institution, choose only one from ['public', 'private', 'university-affiliated',  'corporate research lab']."

what.name: institution.parent_organization
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "parent or affiliated organization, if any (e.g., Harvard University, Fudan University)."

what.name: institution.establishment_year
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "the year the institution was established (e.g., 1996)."

what.name: institution.number_of_staff
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "number of staff or researchers in the institution (e.g., 250)."

what.name: institution.leadership
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "leading figures or directors, e.g., name of the head scientist, director, or notable experts."

what.name: institution.institution_country
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the country where the institution is located (e.g., USA, Japan, China, Germany)."

what.name: institution.institution_city
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the city where the institution is located (e.g., Boston, Tokyo, Beijing, Berlin)."

what.name: institution.research_diseases
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "main diseases that the institution focuses its research on (e.g., breast cancer, diabetes, Alzheimer's disease, inflammatory bowel disease)."

what.name: institution.research_fields
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "main areas or directions of medical research the institution focuses on, choose one or more from ['molecular_biology', 'regenerative_medicine', 'immunology', 'genomics', 'pharmacology', 'oncology', 'neuroscience', 'bioinformatics', 'microbiology', 'epidemiology', 'clinical_research', 'biochemistry', 'cell_biology', 'virology', 'pathology', 'public_health', 'medical_imaging', 'others'], (e.g. molecular_biology || pathology) ."

what.name: institution.key_technologies
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "key technologies, methods, or platforms used by the institution (e.g., automated specimen tracking, X-ray crystallography, CAR-T cell therapy)."

what.name: institution.key_achievements
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "major research achievements, scientific breakthroughs, or certifications obtained by the institution (e.g., ISO15189 certification, protein structure determination, discovery in cardiometabolic diseases)."

what.name: institution.international_collaboration
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "partnerships or collaborations with other institutions or companies, including joint projects and investments (e.g., collaboration between IPC and AP-HM, pharma investment in CAR-T therapy)."

what.name: institution.funding_sources
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "main sources of funding or grants supporting the institution's research, choose one or more from ['government grant', 'industry grant', 'philanthropy', 'self funded', 'international grant', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. government grant)."

what.name: institution.technology_application
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "practical applications or implementations of the institution's technologies in clinical or research settings (e.g., barcode specimen handling, therapy for lipodystrophy, omega-3 supplements for heart health)."

what.name: drug.generic_name
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the standard generic name(s) of the drug (e.g., Sildenafil with Dapoxetine)."

what.name: drug.brand_name
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the commercial or brand name of the drug (e.g., Super Kamagra)."

what.name: drug.disease_name
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the main disease(s) the drug is intended to treat; use standard disease names (e.g., Hypertension, Diabetes Mellitus, Asthma)."

what.name: drug.indication
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the main symptoms, clinical manifestations, or related conditions for which the drug may be used (e.g., fever, pain, edema, high cholesterol, wheezing)."

what.name: drug.active_ingredients
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "active pharmaceutical ingredients in the drug (e.g., Sildenafil||Dapoxetine)."

what.name: drug.pharmaceutical_form
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the physical form in which the drug is administered; choose one or more from ['tablet', 'capsule', 'injection', 'solution', 'cream', 'ointment', 'powder', 'granule', 'suspension', 'patch', 'spray', 'suppository', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. tablet || injection)."

what.name: drug.manufacturer
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the name of the company or manufacturer producing the drug (e.g., Ajanta Pharma)."

what.name: drug.administration_route
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the route through which the drug is administered; choose one or more from ['oral', 'intravenous', 'intramuscular', 'subcutaneous', 'topical', 'transdermal', 'rectal', 'nasal', 'inhalation', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. other)."

what.name: drug.recommended_usage
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "recommended instructions for use, choose one or more from ['swallowed with water', 'chewable', 'dissolve in water', 'take with food', 'take without food', 'take with or without food', 'at fixed time', 'before meals', 'after meals', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. chewable || other)."

what.name: drug.single_dose
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the amount of the drug to be taken at one time per administration,extract all 'population + dose' pairs (e.g., adults 10 mg || children 5 mg || patients with EGPA 3x100 mg)."

what.name: drug.dosage_frequency
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the recommended frequency of administration (e.g., once daily, twice a day, every 8 hours)."

what.name: drug.mechanism_of_action
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "how the drug works in the body to achieve its intended effect (e.g., improves blood circulation in penile vessels, supporting erection)."

what.name: drug.side_effects
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "known or common side effects associated with the drug (e.g., photosensitivity, nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, tenderness)."

what.name: drug.activation_conditions
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "specific conditions or requirements for the drug to take effect; choose one or more from ['requires stimulation', 'requires food', 'requires fasting', 'requires physical activity', 'no special condition', 'requires specific timing', 'requires co-administration with other drugs', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. requires stimulation || requires food)"

what.name: drug.prescription_status
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "whether the drug requires a prescription or can be bought over-the-counter; choose one from ['prescription_only', 'over_the_counter', 'restricted', 'unclassified']."

what.name: drug.unsuitable_population
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "main populations for which the drug is not suitable or should be avoided; specify as described in the document (e.g., children, elderly, pregnant women, patients with renal impairment, children under 12)."

what.name: drug.storage_conditions
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "recommended conditions for storing the drug; choose one or more from ['store at room temperature', 'store in a cool place', 'refrigerate', 'freeze', 'protect from light', 'keep in a dry place', 'keep tightly closed', 'avoid freezing', 'other'], seperated by `||` (e.g. avoid freezing || other)."
